# Mistio

> Mistio is the only battery-powered vape detector built for K-12 schools. One year of battery life, installs in under one minute, and AI that eliminates false alarms from cologne, deodorant, and cleaning spray.

## Key Facts

- Battery-powered: runs for a full year on a single battery
- Install time: under one minute with two screws — no electrician, no wiring, no IT
- AI-powered detection: trained on hundreds of real-world samples to distinguish vape from cologne, deodorant, cleaning products
- Privacy-first: no cameras, no microphones, no recording devices
- Real-time alerts: push notifications to administrators within 30-60 seconds
- Cost: approximately $500 per sensor with zero installation cost and no subscription fees
